## Experiments

* **search-before-searchtext** – The free-text search as it was before the SearchText column (LIKE on Title OR OrganizationName, linguistic collation), for comparison with list-search: reads 2,445, CPU 356 ms, elapsed 358.2 ms. Plan: Clustered Index Scan; Index Scan → Clustered Index Seek
* **search-before-searchtext-rare** – The free-text search as it was before the SearchText column (LIKE on Title OR OrganizationName, linguistic collation), for comparison with list-search-rare: reads 45,590, CPU 418 ms, elapsed 419.65 ms. Plan: Clustered Index Scan; Index Scan → Clustered Index Seek
* **deep-page-keyset** – The same deep page (sorted by title) with keyset paging: continue after the last row of the previous page instead of skipping 49,900 rows, with an index on (Title, Id): reads 321, CPU 0 ms, elapsed 0.0 ms. Plan: Table Scan; Index Seek → Clustered Index Seek
